object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Arrange an outline whose order differs from the objects' ID order, with nested sub-objects. Change objects at several levels, and delete objects: the first one at From, two adjacent ones, and one that follows an unchanged object. Expected: the rows of objects that exist at To follow the outline at To, each object before its sub-objects; each deleted object comes directly after the nearest earlier object at From that exists at To, or first when there is none; adjacent deleted objects keep their order at From.
